node.title: Optimized one-fiber affine coset-pair Stepanov bound
node.statement: At every official dyadic prime-field row, any two nonconstant nonproportional affine forms simultaneously take values in H at fewer than 4n^(2/3) inputs. This is the exact T=1 optimization of the proved in-house Stepanov construction. It improves the older conservative 66n^(2/3) one-fiber corollary but does not change the multi-fiber rich-coset or energy constants.
